rules.statement: The plaintiffs may present parol evidence to interpret the meaning of initials or vilasam in a deed, particularly if they are not commonly intelligible characters.
rules.supporting_quote: "The 98th section 342 of the Evidence Ordinance admits evidence 'to show the meaning of.......not commonly intelligible characters, of technical, local, and provincial expressions, of abbreviations, and of words used in a peculiar sense.'"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: The 98th section 342 of the Evidence Ordinance
